product_notes.DOR/ISL: Initial U.S. Approval 2026 (Idvynso label Highlights). Approved dose DOR 100 mg/ISL 0.25 mg; indication switch only; label sec 14 cites Trials 051 and 052. Also included: 053 (naive, 0.25 mg), 054 (dose-reduction switch), and 0.75 mg trials 017/018/019/020 (unapproved dose, flagged). Label vs CT.gov resistance conflicts for 051/052.
product_notes.ISL: No standalone islatravir US approval (Not applicable). Placeholder row 34 retained conceptually; added ISLEND-1/2 (weekly ISL+LEN; ISL novel agent, absent from comparators) as candidate ISL records with ambiguous-inclusion flag. DOR/ISL trials are recorded under DOR/ISL only.
product_notes.DOR: Initial U.S. Approval 2018 (Pifeltro label). Records: DRIVE-FORWARD, DRIVE-AHEAD (DOR as DOR/3TC/TDF), DRIVE-SHIFT, Opti-DOR, DORA. Pivotal Week 48 resistance for DRIVE-FORWARD not accessible (paper not open access).
product_notes.DOR/TDF/3TC: Initial U.S. Approval 2018 (Delstrigo label). Records: DRIVE-AHEAD, DRIVE-SHIFT, Opti-DOR, DORA.
product_notes.EFV: Initial U.S. Approval 1998 (Sustiva label). Label sec 14 cites Study 006 and ACTG 364 (ACTG 364 is Phase 2 on CT.gov -> excluded). Many post-approval trials use EFV only as comparator (excluded). Coverage of older investigator-initiated EFV strategy trials may be incomplete.
product_notes.EFV/TDF/FTC: Initial U.S. Approval 2006 (Atripla label, PTC 2013 version). Label cites Study 934 (naive) and Study 073 (switch; Phase 4 on CT.gov -> excluded). No Snapshot data for 934 (pre-Snapshot era).
product_notes.EFV/TDF/3TC: Symfi Initial U.S. Approval 2018; no DailyMed label found under 'Symfi Lo'. Symfi label sec 14.1 cites Trial 903 (EFV+3TC+TDF co-administered vs d4T) -> placeholder row 27 replaced by Study 903 record (flagged). No Symfi Lo (EFV 400)-specific Phase 3 with efficacy primary found; NAMSAL uses EFV400/TDF/3TC only as comparator.
